text: The authors state that their setup requires certifying the correctness of prover answers, relying on a math training set with known ground-truth answers, and anticipate it is less relevant where collecting any ground truth is too hard or expensive; they suggest hoping for favourable out-of-distribution generalization of legibility but do not study it.
title: Checkability training needs ground-truth answer labels
